title: S1 draft B: receipt (C1), render rule (C2), authority stage (C4), custody (C5), evidence graph
objective: Write contract section B: the receipt schema with the three-field verdict, typed gate outcomes and reasons, claim eligibility, the relative render rule, the authority-stage record, the anchor/custody interface, the evidence-graph binding and invalidation rules, and E01-E05 cases with expected facts.
problem: Plan s3 Receipt: schema, claim, policy, cell revision, code/inputs/outputs, oracle, dependency edges, expected-answer identity, execution status and resources. Anchors: separately retained exact evidence-node identities and a terminal attempted-run inventory, with who supplied them and when; in-memory synthetic anchors remain software fixtures. Gate: expected typed verdict plus reason; a claim needs every applicable prerequisite; an unrelated failure must not revoke an independent claim. Closure C1: three fields -- execution {RAN; BLOCKED with what was missing}, instrument authority {QUALIFIED at stage X; UNQUALIFIED with why}, outcome (gate: PASS/FAIL on a named predicate with reason; ruler: POSITIVE/NEGATIVE/NOT_SHOWN); eligibility is the worst of the three; the report prints all three. C2: a claim renders only with what it is relative to (comparator set, intervention set, or class and exact bound) and its cell and setting; class/any/all/no only beside an exact bound. C4: each gate record carries author-tested | first-sight challenged (date, cases, edits, denominators, score) | closed after repair (closure score); a claim inherits the lowest stage among its gates and prints it. C5: an anchor-keeper field (named keeper and form, or NONE -> custody UNQUALIFIED; C-004-OP2). E01-E05 per plan s4; E05 must not promise that hashes detect internally consistent lies (closure D10).
non_goals: No redesign of the RSO and no reopening of the closed design review (CLOSURE_REVIEW_v0.4 G)
Do not copy code, tests or verdict policies from the Fable or ASTRA harnesses; they are reference and adversarial corpora (SOURCES.md B; NEXT_ROUND_PLAN_v0.4 s1)
No five-valued verdict and no collapsed verdict (closure C1, D.2)
evidence_required: a receipt field table (name, type, required, meaning) covering plan s3 Receipt and C1
the eligibility ordering, the C2 render grammar with one accepted and one refused rendering, the C4 stage record and its inheritance rule, the C5 custody field
E01-E05 each with a true case and a false case, expected typed verdict and reason, or a stated coupling
